title: Normalized coherent tensor powers of twists
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $P=\operatorname{Proj} k[x_0,x_1]$ [def-sc-p1-standard], with twists $L_n=\mathcal O_P(n)$ and coordinate sections $x_i:\mathcal O_P\to L_1$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. Suppose morphisms $\mu_{n,m}:L_n\otimes L_m\to L_{n+m}$ are isomorphisms and send every pure tensor of sections to the pointwise product in the prime localization. Then there are isomorphisms $e^+_a:L_1^{\otimes a}\cong L_a$ and $e^-_a:(L_1^\vee)^{\otimes a}\cong L_{-a}$ for $a\in\mathbf N$, where the dual and its evaluation are as in [lem-sc-invertible-dual]. The degree-zero positive morphism is the canonical unit morphism $1\mapsto1$, and $e^+_0=e^-_0$. For each $a$ and $i$, tensoring with $x_i$ and then multiplying agrees with the positive successor identification, with the braiding which exchanges $L_1$ and its tensor power. The negative successor square agrees with braiding $L_1$ to the front, reassociating, applying $L_1\otimes L_1^\vee\to\mathcal O_P$, and then $e^-_a$. These are precisely the two morphism equalities displayed in the Lean signature. No multiplication morphism is constructed and no coordinate nonvanishing locus is asserted.

proof.text: Use Proj.unitIsoTwistZero in degree zero for both families. Its hom is the displayed unitToTwist of 1: extensionality on sections and points reduces this to s = s times Localization.mk 1 1. Define the positive family recursively as braiding, the previous isomorphism whiskered on the right, asIso of mu(a,1), and the integer degree cast. Symmetry cancels the two braidings in the successor square, which remains true after precomposition by tensoring any coordinate section.

The polynomial variables generate the graded algebra, so Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top' gives the degree-one chart cover. Apply Proj.isInvertible_twist to this cover, and use isIso_dualEvaluation for L=O(1), with D its dual. The evaluation isomorphism makes tensorRight L an equivalence with inverse tensorRight D (BraidedCategory.tensorRightEquivalence). This works with Fin 2 in universe zero and k in any universe; the narrower polynomial-twist instance is not used.

Suppose eNeg(a) has been constructed. Define q from D^(a+1) tensor L to O(-(a+1)) tensor L by braiding L to the front, inverse associator, evaluation whiskered by D^a, left unitor, eNeg(a), the degree cast, and the inverse of mu(-(a+1),1). Define eNeg(a+1) as the preimageIso of q under tensorRight L. Functor.map_preimage gives its whiskered hom equal to q.hom. Cancel the inverse multiplication with multiplication and the two opposite degree casts to obtain the full evaluation successor equality. Precompose with the right-unitor inverse and tensoring the coordinate section to obtain the requested negative square. Both zero isomorphisms are definitionally the same unit isomorphism. Assemble these identities in a generic, fully proved private theorem for any indexed family of unit-to-L(1) sections, then specialize to the two coordinate sections with explicit grading parameters. The private normalization and invertibility proofs keep this specialization from expanding chart data.

theorem projectiveLine_twist_coherent_powers (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (μ : ∀ n m : ℤ,
        Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n ⊗
          Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m ⟶
            Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (n + m))
    (hiso : ∀ n m : ℤ, IsIso (μ n m))
    (hmul : (∀ (n m : ℤ) (U : (Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Opens)
        (s : Γ(Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n, U))
        (t : Γ(Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m, U)) (x : U),
        (((μ n m).app U (tmulSection s t)).1 x :
            Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) =
          (s.1 x : Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) * (t.1 x))) :
    (∃ (ePos : ∀ a : ℕ,
          (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1).tensorPow a ≅
            Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (a : ℤ))
        (eNeg : ∀ a : ℕ,
          (dual (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1)).tensorPow a ≅
            Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (-(a : ℤ))),
        (ePos 0).hom =
            Proj.unitToTwist (𝒜 := MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
                (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg
                (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)) (by norm_num)) ∧
        ePos 0 = eNeg 0 ∧
        (∀ (a : ℕ) (i : Fin 2),
          (ρ_ _).inv ≫
              (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1).tensorPow a ◁
                Proj.unitToTwist
                  (𝒜 := MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
                  (MvPolynomial.X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k i) ≫
              (ePos a).hom ▷ _ ≫ μ (a : ℤ) 1 =
            (ρ_ _).inv ≫
              (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1).tensorPow a ◁
                Proj.unitToTwist
                  (𝒜 := MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
                  (MvPolynomial.X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k i) ≫
              (β_ _ _).hom ≫ (ePos (a + 1)).hom ≫ eqToHom (congrArg
                (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)) (by omega))) ∧
        (∀ (a : ℕ) (i : Fin 2),
          (ρ_ _).inv ≫
              (dual (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1)).tensorPow
                (a + 1) ◁ Proj.unitToTwist
                  (𝒜 := MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
                  (MvPolynomial.X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k i) ≫
              (eNeg (a + 1)).hom ▷ _ ≫ μ (-((a + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) 1 ≫
                eqToHom (congrArg
                  (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)) (by omega)) =
            (ρ_ _).inv ≫
              (dual (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1)).tensorPow
                (a + 1) ◁ Proj.unitToTwist
                  (𝒜 := MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
                  (MvPolynomial.X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k i) ≫
              (β_ _ _).hom ≫
              (α_ (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1)
                (dual (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1))
                ((dual (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1)).tensorPow
                  a)).inv ≫
              dualEvaluation (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1) ▷
                (dual (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) 1)).tensorPow a ≫
              (λ_ _).hom ≫ (eNeg a).hom))
